fusions.name: Priest's Knock
fusions.desc: Only strikes a target at or below 30% health, and that threshold rises with each rank. The knock deals 20 damage, uses up every affliction on the target for 1.4 times the damage they had left to deal, and leaves it [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Thrashing Shallows
fusions.desc: Slams the ground and throws up water, dealing 7 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles with a 50% chance to leave each [Soaked] for 6 seconds. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Bait and Brace
fusions.desc: Increases your dodge chance by 20% for 12 seconds, and up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles turn on you for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Silver Turnabout
fusions.desc: Every time you dodge a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 5. The next ability you use spends them all, and a blow strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 34% of your weapon damage per stack.
